```sql
WITH product_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_key,
        p.product_name,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS gross_revenue,
        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0), 2) AS total_refunds,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0), 2) AS net_revenue,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total - (oi.quantity * p.unit_cost)) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0), 2) AS net_profit
    FROM products p
    JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_key = oi.product_key
    LEFT JOIN returns r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id AND oi.line_number = r.line_number
    GROUP BY p.product_key, p.product_name, p.category
)
SELECT 
    product_key,
    product_name,
    category,
    total_units_sold,
    gross_revenue,
    total_refunds,
    net_revenue,
    net_profit
FROM product_metrics
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
